# Voktera

> Personal dashboard for food logging, gym tracking, and daily tasks.

- Website: https://voktera.com
- Web app: https://app.voktera.com
- Support: support@voktera.com

## Pages

- Home: https://voktera.com/
- Changelog: https://voktera.com/changelog
- Privacy: https://voktera.com/privacy
- Terms: https://voktera.com/terms
- Cookies: https://voktera.com/cookies

## Product

Voktera is a mobile-first progressive web app. Users sign in with email OTP. Features include meal and nutrient tracking, workout plans and logging, todos, and goals.
